title: 五所百强大学：转化缺口，河套园区真能补上？
speaker: Kevin Choi

segments.en: What do you oversee where the current gaps are you think and what are you looking to upgrade? Well, you know the innovation and technology will be a driving force not just for Hong Kong but I guess for the world.
segments.zh: 您负责哪些领域？您认为当前差距在哪里？您希望提升什么？创新科技将成为香港乃至全球的驱动力。

segments.en: And in fact, Hong Kong given the lies status as an international financial sector, we need to grow a real economy beyond finance sector.
segments.zh: 事实上，香港作为国际金融中心，我们需要在金融领域之外发展实体经济。

segments.en: So it's a natural for innovation and technology to take this stage as the second growth engine of Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 因此，创新科技自然成为香港的第二增长引擎。

segments.en: And also, you know that we are already as kickstarting how we develop the loft and matchopolis.
segments.zh: 此外，我们已启动如何发展北部都会区。

segments.en: A vast land mass in between Hong Kong, within Hong Kong, of course, but also adjacent to the Chinese mainland.
segments.zh: 这是一片广阔的土地，位于香港境内，当然也毗邻中国内地。

segments.en: This is an important development for Hong Kong, but we have to fill in what kind of industries that are high value at and also that shows Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 这对香港是重要发展，但我们必须填充高价值且能展示香港的产业。

segments.en: And it goes without saying that innovation and technology will be the key of it and green technology like the one that we are promoting today on one of the summit and also the day
segments.zh: 不言而喻，创新科技将是关键，而绿色科技正如我们今天在峰会上所推广的，以及前一天我们举办的绿色创新会议。

segments.en: before we have bow and roll green innovation conference too.
segments.zh: 前一天我们还举办了绿色创新会议。

segments.en: These are very important areas, not just for Hong Kong again, for globally on the sustainable development and environmental friendly protection.
segments.zh: 这些是非常重要的领域，不仅对香港，也对全球可持续发展和环境保护。

segments.en: So my task is to ensure that quite some new science parks, apart from the Parkcheck Golf Science Park, we now have, we are now developing the Loop Hong Kong Park, which is really adjacent
segments.zh: 我的任务是确保除了香港科学园，我们还在发展河套香港园区，它真的毗邻

segments.en: to the Shenzhen River and adjacent to Shenzhen, the powerhouse of innovation of China.
segments.zh: 延伸至深圳河，毗邻深圳——中国的创新重镇。

segments.en: And then, of course, and other aspects like I have, as you said, there are gaps between a very strong academic background Hong Kong already have, because we have like five top
segments.zh: 当然，还有其他方面，正如你所说，香港已有很强的学术基础，但我们之间还存在差距，因为香港有五所全球顶尖

segments.en: But these research and development needs to come to flirtation, commercialization.
segments.zh: 但这些研发需要走向转化和商业化。

segments.en: These are some gaps that I am now filling in through government funding, through support programs, through the park development, etc.
segments.zh: 这些正是我正在通过政府资助、支持计划、园区发展等方式填补的差距。
